atoms.1: Augmentin is not the same thing as amoxicillin.
atoms.3: Augmentin contains amoxicillin and clavulanic acid.
atoms.5: Amoxicillin can treat a variety of bacterial infections.
atoms.6: Clavulanic acid is a beta-lactamase inhibitor.

snippets.output: Augmentin is not the same thing as amoxicillin; it is a combination antibiotic containing amoxicillin and clavulanic acid.
Amoxicillin is a penicillin-type antibiotic that can treat a variety of bacterial infections.

Clavulanic acid is a beta-lactamase inhibitor that is added to Augmentin to overcome bacterial resistance: certain bacteria produce the enzyme beta-lactamase, which inhibits this enzyme that would otherwise inactivate amoxicillin.
snippets.notes: Pattern B causal chain: clavulanic acid added → mechanism (inhibits beta-lactamase) → why (the enzyme would otherwise inactivate amoxicillin).
